matches.note: Billed as the opening GTT4 rematch of Hoyt Williams and Vangelus Olsig. Hoyt, sick with the flu, rammed Olsig into the exposed turnbuckle in full view of Thomas Giles, who ordered him back to the ring to finish the match; Olsig then caught him with a slingshot dropkick into the steel and pinned him.

matches.title: prime-2003-intense
matches.note: Intense Title defence against an opponent hand-picked by Eve: Trashcan Man beat Token Weed with a Pyro Driver within a minute, after which Vangelus Olsig split his head open with the nail-studded barbed-wire chair and demanded a title shot.
Billed as Ellis Easton against Aimz. Aimz nearly won with a swinging DDT; Easton sprayed her in the eyes with cologne from under the ring and pinned her with a handful of her pants.
Billed as Justin Williamson against Tyler Lopez. Lopez won with the Flash Nightmare, a submission of Jackson Darilek's, after pulling Williamson back up from a pin of his own.

A non-title match. Killean Sirrajin debuted a new finish, the Last Call (a dragon sleeper with a chicken wing), and Vetra tapped out; Hoyt Williams watched from the stage in a golden chair, pretending to snore.

Billed as Teh Pwn against Team Zambo. Dave Gibson pinned Vangellus Oxios after a leaping piledriver; Los Diablos then beat down both teams, and the match turned into a brawl of the Flying Vergomovs, the Killer Pirates, the Covenant, Civil Disobedience and Pranks With Attitude until Hin See stopped it.

A Submission Match. Angelo Deville made Brandon Youngblood tap out to the Soprano; Youngblood attacked him afterwards, Nova pulled him off, and Melissa Youngblood-Garvin slid the 5-Star Title in so that Youngblood could knock Nova down with it and leave with the belt.

matches.note: Singles Match, the PRIME debut of Kasper Sky with his manager Athena Alexandria. Lopez's manager Passion struck Lopez with a high-heeled shoe when he reached the ropes; Sky then landed the Fatal Fury, a senton bomb from the top, for the pin.

Booked as a Janitorial Room Brawl, moved into a corridor because the room was too small: any weapon from the supplies cupboard was legal and only a pinfall ended it. Steven Lee threw bleach into Adam St. Ours's face; Munson then hit the Munslam and the referee counted three.
Singles Match. Mike E. Dangerously attacked The Buzz's old knee injury and nearly won with an inverted double arm DDT, but The Buzz hid a low blow from the referee, hit the Buzzed and pinned him.

Tag Team Match. Steve Starr hit Tony Zatarok with a steel chair behind the referee's back and Killean Sirrajin pinned him with the Supreme Justice; afterwards Toshiaki Motoki awarded Sirrajin his Choose Your Own Destiny prize, an Intense Title match.
Boda's in-ring debut, a non-title match against the Intense Champion in Charlotte. Boda powerbombed Kincade through the announce table and won by count-out; Kasper Sky then mocked the win.
Fatal Fourway Match, with Black Angel and Poet as stablemates. Black Angel trapped Shadow in the Dark Halo and Shadow tapped out, with Adam too late to break it up.

Bible Bash Match, with a gold-plated Bible hung above the ring as a legal weapon and Joey Troy on commentary. Referee Jimmy Turner was knocked down by the Bible; Ignatius Lisieux then hit Rolo with it and Hoyt Williams pinned him.
